refnamediv.refpurpose: APIs for querying and changing the system clock and timezone settings

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Timedate is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

Describe() returns the current time (TimeUSec), the configured timezone (Timezone), whether the RTC is in local time (LocalRTC), whether NTP synchronization is enabled (NTP), whether it has completed (NTPSynchronized), whether the system supports NTP at all (CanNTP), and the RTC's view of the time (RTCTimeUSec). ListTimezones() returns every timezone name the system knows about.

SetTime(), SetTimezone(), SetLocalRTC() and SetNTP() change the corresponding setting, mirroring the D-Bus methods of the same name on org.freedesktop.timedate15. SetTime() is refused with AutomaticTimeSyncEnabled while NTP synchronization is enabled, and the NTP-related calls are refused with NoNTPSupport if the build has no NTP support.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: The interface is served by systemd-timedated.service8 on the /run/systemd/io.systemd.Timedate socket, which is world-connectable (SocketMode=0666). The Set*() methods authenticate through the polkit actions org.freedesktop.timedate1.set-time, org.freedesktop.timedate1.set-timezone, org.freedesktop.timedate1.set-local-rtc and org.freedesktop.timedate1.set-ntp, which default to administrator authentication; interactive authentication is requested when the caller sets allowInteractiveAuthentication. Describe() and ListTimezones() need no authentication.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs for querying and changing the system clock and timezone settings. interface io.systemd.Timedate
# Returns the time zone, RTC mode, NTP status and current system and RTC time in one call. method Describe() -> ( # The configured system time zone. Null if none could be determined. Timezone: ?string, # Whether the RTC is maintained in local time rather than UTC. LocalRTC: bool, # Whether a network time synchronization service is installed. CanNTP: bool, # Whether automatic time synchronization via a network time service is enabled. NTP: bool, # Whether the system clock is synchronized. NTPSynchronized: bool, # The current system time, in µs since the UNIX epoch. TimeUSec: int, # The current time of the RTC, in µs since the UNIX epoch. Null if it could not be read. RTCTimeUSec: ?int )
# Returns the list of known time zones. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListTimezones() -> ( # One known time zone. timezone: string )
# Sets the system time zone. method SetTimezone( # The time zone to set, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin' or 'Asia/Tokyo'. Must be a valid, installed time zone. timezone: string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Configures whether the RTC is maintained in local time or UTC. method SetLocalRTC( # If true the RTC is maintained in local time, otherwise in UTC. localRTC: bool, # If true the system clock is updated from the RTC, otherwise the RTC is updated from the system clock. Defaults to false. adjustSystemClock: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets the system clock. method SetTime( # The time to set, in µs. If 'relative' is true this is an offset to the current system time (and may be negative), otherwise an absolute timestamp in µs since the UNIX epoch. timeUSec: int, # If true 'timeUSec' is interpreted relative to the current system time, otherwise as an absolute timestamp. Defaults to false. relative: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Enables or disables automatic time synchronization via a network time service. The reply is delayed until the relevant units have been started or stopped. method SetNTP( # If true, enables automatic time synchronization via a network time service, otherwise disables it. useNTP: bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Returned when the clock cannot be set because automatic time synchronization (NTP) is enabled, or a previous enablement request is still in progress. error AutomaticTimeSyncEnabled()
# Returned when automatic time synchronization cannot be configured because no network time service is installed. error NoNTPSupport()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Timedate shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Timedate.Describe '{}' invokes its Describe() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Timedate interface was added in version 263.
AutomaticTimeSyncEnabled, Describe(), ListTimezones(), NoNTPSupport, SetLocalRTC(), SetNTP(), SetTime(), and SetTimezone() were added in version 263.
